routing: OpenRouter's routing criterion is chosen on the agent's or area's model, in project Settings; there is no control here. On OpenRouter, each call also carries a price ceiling (1.5 × the catalog price): only an upstream within it serves; if none does, the call is retried once without a ceiling.
